question.title: Question
question.description: What are players predicting? e.g. "Who will win the next challenge?"

optionsSource.title: Options
optionsSource.description: Predict one of the custom options, or one of the players in the game

options.title: Custom options
options.description: Used when Options is "custom". Needs at least 2; otherwise the players are used instead.

allowMultipleOutcomes.title: Allow several outcomes
allowMultipleOutcomes.description: The host may mark several options as correct (ties).
